LOCAL LIFT CONTROL

Controlled by the ESP32

Offline sensor control with optional dashboard buttons

Waiting for device readings

Dashboard commands are optional. Sensor control works offline.

Physical Up: GPIO15 / Down: GPIO33. Click once to move; click again to stop. Both pressed stops the motor.

Water raw > 0 AND level > 0 requests Up; either at zero requests Down. Travel limits and local safety checks apply, with or without Wi-Fi.

SAVED MEASUREMENTS

Sensor & weather history

Every accepted controller reading, paired with the latest weather snapshot available at receipt.

Weather refreshes every 10 minutes. Each row retains the snapshot and its age; missing weather stays unavailable. River discharge is modeled. Historical rows never change when settings change.
